verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a broad API (120+ actions) covering registration, transfer, renewal, delete/push, DNS/nameserver adjustments, and reseller management, which supports scripting domain registration into a deploy workflow. However, no evidence pack item shows a concrete end-to-end documented call sequence (contact profile creation/assignment via API, explicit purchase endpoint with pricing/payment, and nameserver setting in one flow) or an OpenAPI/reference spec (probe found only 404s for openapi endpoints), so the end-to-end scriptability is asserted at a high level rather than demonstrated with call-by-call docs. missing for 10: explicit API reference/OpenAPI spec showing purchase+contact+nameserver calls chained together, and independent/hands-on confirmation of a full registration script.
